verdict.rationale: FireHydrant's docs show strong Slack-based incident declaration: auto-created incident Slack channels, a default Runbook that assigns the Commander role, `/fh` slash commands to run Runbooks and post updates that populate the incident's status page (firehydrant-docs-2, -7, -8, -28, -41, -65). However, evidence never mentions Microsoft Teams support for declaring/running incidents — all chat-ops evidence is Slack-only. Missing for 10: explicit Microsoft Teams incident-declaration/chatops support, independent hands-on confirmation of the Slack flow.
